image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a disposable plastic lighter. The body is translucent green plastic with a silver-colored metal wind guard/shield at the top. A black plastic spark wheel and striker assembly are visible on the side. The background is a blurred grey textured surface.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The black plastic components exhibit a slightly 'waxy' or melted appearance. The serrations on the spark wheel lack crisp, mechanical edges and appear somewhat smoothed out, suggesting minor generative softness or failure to render fine mechanical detail accurately.

artifact_observations.location: Junction of metal shield and plastic body (right side)
artifact_observations.reasoning: The boundary where the silver metal hood meets the green plastic body is slightly indistinct. There is a subtle 'bleeding' effect where the materials seem to fuse rather than having a sharp, manufactured seam.

There are faint markings on the metal that resemble text or safety warnings, but they are illegible and morph into noise, which is common in AI generations attempting to replicate industrial stamping.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the spark wheel. In real lighters, this is a precise mechanical part with sharp teeth. AI often smears this into a generic bumpy texture. Also, check if the metal shield looks like it's actually attached to the plastic or just floating/fused. The text on top is likely gibberish—confirm if it looks like failed OCR generation.
